### Bible Pathway - Mar. 19, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-19-2012.html
Passage: Joshua 19:49-50
Points:
- Joshua demonstrated genuine humility by waiting until every Israelite tribe received their allotment before claiming any land for himself.
- Instead of using his authority to take prime territory, he requested an obscure and rugged inheritance at Timnath-serah.
- He prioritized spiritual closeness to the Lord over material gain by choosing a site near the Tabernacle at Shiloh.
- Godly leadership finds its greatest reward not in earthly wealth or recognition, but in obediently serving and pleasing God.
